prompt: Our pen test last quarter found two holes in this documents API, one in access control and one in input handling. We fixed them, but nobody wrote tests that would catch them coming back, and I would not be surprised if other checks are just as loose. Please build a regression suite for the access control and input handling code: sessions and tokens, roles and permissions, who can read which document, the file download handler, input validation, the HTML export, and the login limiter. Put it in test/security.test.js (you may also add or extend other files under test/), keep the suite runnable with `node --test --test-timeout=4000 test`, and remove any temporary files your tests create. Do not change anything under src/, and do not add dependencies or change the package or CI files.

rubric.criterion: The cases explain the security behavior they protect in readable test names and assertions (code cannot check this because wording and intent require human review).
Temporary files and directories are cleaned up even when a storage assertion fails (code cannot check this because cleanup quality is a review concern beyond the command result).
